description: Release packaging is deny-by-default. The project-authored software shell is approved now; production character GLBs remain absent from approved_paths until ORIGINAL v1 promotion is explicitly approved.
gates: Every shipped path must be explicitly approved.
Final ORIGINAL character assets must have clean-room provenance evidence.
Production runtime must have zero unresolved third-party runtime dependencies.
Reference renders, legacy characters and Blender working files are excluded.
MakeHuman-derived embedded anatomical arrays and their generator are excluded from the standalone release path.
